channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Alonzo Mourning | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Alonzo Mourning from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mario Chalmers on Pat Riley, Erik Spoelstra, Alonzo Mourning
item.description:
Chalmers is among the Heat’s all-time leaders in steals (second), games played (fourth), assists (fourth), three-pointers made (fifth) and minutes played (sixth).

“I still talk to Spo [coach Erik Spoelstra],I still talk to Pat Riley, I still talk to Alonzo [Mourning],”

Mario Chalmers on Pat Riley, Erik Spoelstra, Alonzo Mourning, Jul 21, 2023. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Patrick Ewing on Alonzo Mourning
item.description:
Patrick Ewing was watching Jimmy Butler knock down shot after shot Monday night when he got the urge to reach out to an old friend.

“I’m looking at Miami come back and win and Jimmy have 56 points, and I called Alonzo right after that game,”

Patrick Ewing on Alonzo Mourning, Apr 28, 2023. Source: Newsday.

item.title: Pat Riley on Dwyane Wade, Alonzo Mourning, Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Riley told the Miami Herlad.

“I go back to [Alonzo Mourning] and Zo was a franchise face and then Dwyane [Wade] along with Udonis [Haslem], andnow I look at Bam Adebayo the same way because of longevity. I see Bam here, I hope, for his whole career.”

Pat Riley on Dwyane Wade, Alonzo Mourning, Bam Adebayo, Feb 17, 2023. Source: Heat Nation.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Alonzo Mourning
item.description:
In a recent episode of The Big Podcast with Shaq, O’Neal revealed how he did just that:

“I had beef with Alonzo Mourning. And then when he came to the Miami Heat, I had to sit him down and apologize,”

Shaquille O'Neal on Alonzo Mourning, Sep 3, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Alonzo Mourning, Patrick Ewing
item.description:
Mark Cuban:

“Just the kids, right? The guys, they’re different. When I first got in, it was a very macho industry and we we’re just coming out of the 90s. And you had guys who just beat the hell out of each other. It was all about who was tough and who wasn’t. You had Shaq banging on people you had Alonzo Mourning. Patrick Ewing was at the end of his career. But, you had guys that were just all about the physical and what kind of dominance could you establish in the paint. And remember all the grief that Dirk used to get, ‘oh, he can’t — why isn’t he in the paint? Why isn’t he in the paint?’ And and that’s changed.”

Mark Cuban on Alonzo Mourning, Patrick Ewing, Apr 24, 2021. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Yao Ming, Alonzo Mourning
item.description:
“The reason that I will average 40 is the fact there's no Shaq, Alonzo Mourning, Yao Ming back there. I don't know who's protecting this rim, but I'm pretty sure a 6-foot-5 power forward ain't stopping me from getting to the bucket,”

Gilbert Arenas on Yao Ming, Alonzo Mourning, Jan 6, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Tony Smith on Alonzo Mourning
item.description:
James and Davis are now up 1-0 on a Miami team with Riley's DNA.

“When I look at the Heat team, they remind me of guys like Alonzo Mourning,”

Tony Smith on Alonzo Mourning, Oct 2, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Patrick Ewing on Alonzo Mourning
item.description:
“Pat used to get mad when he was the Knicks’ coach and I’d go out with Alonzo and Dikembe,”

Patrick Ewing on Alonzo Mourning, Jan 3, 2019. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Andy Elisburg on LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, Shaquille O'Neal, Alonzo Mourning
item.description:
“It was an incredible, magical time having Dwyane be a part of the Miami Heat. He's been such a huge part of the history here. He's the greatest player in the history of the franchise. Obviously, we've had lots of incredible players here who have had incredible seasons, including, obviously, LeBron, who won MVPs here. And Shaq [O'Neal]. And Zo [Alonzo Mourning].”

Andy Elisburg on LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, Shaquille O'Neal, Alonzo Mourning, Mar 27, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kevin Johnson on Alonzo Mourning, Mitch Richmond, Spencer Haywood
item.description:
Sacramento Mayor Kevin Johnson on being named a finalist for the 2014 Basketball Hall of Fame:Via official statement from his office:

“It is a tremendous honor to be chosen as a finalist for the Hall of Fame and I am sincerely humbled. It is especially gratifying to be recognized by the Committee for all of the hard work and effort we all put into the game. To be considered along with three great peers of mine, Tim (Hardaway), (Alonzo Mourning, and (Mitch Richmond), as well as (Spencer Haywood), is icing on the cake,”

Kevin Johnson on Alonzo Mourning, Mitch Richmond, Spencer Haywood, Feb 15, 2014. Source: Sulia.
